quotes.speaker: Jamal Shead
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamal Shead on the team's struggles and maintaining perspective
quotes.excerpt: realize that it's a long season and don't overreact.
quotes.quote: Realize that it's a long season and don't overreact. I think we are struggling, but we were struggling last year, we figured it out and we got on a roll. So we just got to figure out how to get on a roll and once we get it and find it, just maintain it.
quotes.social_post: Jamal Shead on the Raptors current struggles: Realize that it is a long season and do not overreact. We were struggling last year, we figured it out and we got on a roll. We just have to figure out how to get on a roll again.

structured.context: Jamal Shead discusses the team's early season struggles and the need to maintain perspective.

quotes.speaker: Jamal Shead
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamal Shead on team emotions and handling aggressive feedback
quotes.excerpt: to hear the message and not just the tone of the voice.
quotes.quote: Emotions run high. You could be playing the best game of your life, things go wrong, you lash out for two seconds and people recognize that instead of realizing that it's a moment of passion. I don't think we had any lashing out, I think we've had conversations and all of us are grown and we understand that when somebody yells or somebody even talks to us in an aggressive tone, to hear the message and not just the tone of the voice.
quotes.social_post: Jamal Shead on handling aggressive feedback from teammates: We are all grown and we understand that when somebody yells or talks to us in an aggressive tone, to hear the message and not just the tone of the voice.

structured.context: Jamal Shead addresses how the team handles aggressive communication and emotions during games.

quotes.speaker: Jamal Shead
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamal Shead on the value of playing time for young players
quotes.excerpt: a lot of guys are getting a lot of minutes that is going to prepare them.
quotes.quote: A lot of guys are getting a lot of minutes that is going to prepare them for whenever we actually do need like playoffs. Playoffs last year helped me help cope Jameson so much. When you get that experience, you just feel better about yourself. You know that you're ready for any type of moment instead of just wondering if you're ready for the moment. So I think a lot of guys have taken the opportunity upon themselves to really perform and take the minutes and the opportunity they have while Scottie was out, while Kawhi is out, while RJ is out.
quotes.social_post: Jamal Shead says the current rotation minutes are vital for the young Raptors: When you get that experience, you just feel better about yourself. You know that you are ready for any type of moment.

structured.context: Jamal Shead explains how increased playing time for young players due to injuries helps their development.

quotes.speaker: Jamal Shead
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamal Shead on the team's internal standards and finishing games
quotes.excerpt: we're good enough, we showed that we're good enough and we're having these leads.
quotes.quote: We don't really pay attention to outside expectation. When I say expectation, I say like our standard. We love to play hard, we love to crash off the glass, we love to share the ball. So just playing the right way and playing to whatever we think our standard is and try to get a win out of that because we're good enough, we showed that we're good enough and we're having these leads and the fact that we're having these leads shows that we're good enough. We just got to learn how to finish games a little better.
quotes.social_post: Jamal Shead on the Raptors identity: We do not really pay attention to outside expectation. We love to play hard, we love to crash off the glass, we love to share the ball. We just have to learn how to finish games a little better.

structured.context: Jamal Shead discusses the team's internal standards and the need to improve at finishing games.

quotes.speaker: Jamal Shead
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamal Shead on the importance of communication with changing lineups
quotes.excerpt: just communicating. When you're playing a different brand of basketball with different people, you got to learn them.
quotes.quote: Just communicating. When you're playing a different brand of basketball with different people, you got to learn them. But I think for the most part, we're doing a good job of learning each other. We're doing a good job of playing together. We just got to clean up some stuff and finish games. That's really all it is.
quotes.social_post: Jamal Shead on the team chemistry: When you are playing a different brand of basketball with different people, you have to learn them. We are doing a good job of learning each other.

quotes.speaker: Jamal Shead
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamal Shead on consistency and being there for the team
quotes.excerpt: you're not going to be perfect every night, you're not going to be the best every night.
quotes.quote: It's game to game. You're not going to be perfect every night, you're not going to be the best every night, but you got to do what you got to do to help the team win. So I think sometimes I don't play the best, but I'm always going to be there when they need me and when it's time for winning time. So I wouldn't say it's inconsistency, it's just how the season has went so far.
quotes.social_post: Jamal Shead on his role: You are not going to be perfect every night, but you have to do what you have to do to help the team win. I am always going to be there when they need me and when it is time for winning time.

structured.context: Jamal Shead reflects on his own consistency and his commitment to helping the team win.

quotes.speaker: Jamal Shead
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamal Shead on the importance of ball movement and flow
quotes.excerpt: when you go out there and flow and you let guys find the ball, you move the ball.
quotes.quote: The problem is I'm thinking about that too much. When you go out there and flow and you let guys find the ball, you let the ball find you, you just move the ball. I think Milwaukee game, the first time when we were in Milwaukee is a very, very good example of that. We didn't have Scottie, we didn't have Kawhi, we still moved the ball. We had almost a franchise record in assists, but you don't see us playing with those group of guys that much anymore because we have Scottie, we have RJ, we have Kawhi. So it's just letting the ball move and stop thinking so much.
quotes.social_post: Jamal Shead on the Raptors offense: The problem is I am thinking about that too much. When you go out there and flow and you let guys find the ball, you let the ball find you, you just move the ball. Stop thinking so much.

structured.context: Jamal Shead talks about the importance of ball movement and not overthinking during games.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on Scottie Barnes' development and finishing at the rim
quotes.excerpt: it's part of his growth, so for a big part of his career he was always the guy.
quotes.quote: It's part of his growth, so for a big part of his career and coming from college and high school, he was always the guy that was just forced to the rim and finishing at the rim. And I think that he's really good at that and I think that he really improved in his finishes around the rim. Now for his next stage of the growth is going to be getting that mid-range done as well and he's doing a really, really good job at that.
